read_me: Items are ranked best first. This file is complete only if the last key is "complete":true; otherwise your fetch was truncated, so say so. Items that did not fit are in signals_digest_more.json (same format).

legend.tier: source credibility prior: A official, B trusted tracker or analyst, C reporter or aggregator, D anonymous; absent for markets
legend.sid: x only: the post URL is https://x.com/<by>/status/<sid>
legend.text: headline or post text, trimmed harder for lower-ranked items
legend.flags: leak = rumor or leak vocabulary; soon = forward-looking vocabulary; id = a Claude model id or name in the text; newid = an identifier not seen in the earlier days; rising = engagement climbing fast; trip = tripwire (registry, status component, careers, sitemap, watched page changed)
legend.corr: distinct authors who mentioned the same new identifier
legend.new_lines: new text on a watched page
